home.sub: Simple music tools that work the second the page opens.
home.h1: Free online guitar tuner, metronome and guitar chords

tuner.tapString: Tap a string to pick it and hear its note
tuner.autoHint: Auto: play any string and it is picked for you
tuner.nomic: No microphone access — tap a string to tune by ear.
tuner.how1: Tap “Tap to tune” and allow the microphone.
tuner.how2: Play one string. The meter shows if it is flat or sharp.
tuner.how3: Turn the peg until the centre bars turn green.

accuracy.h2: How we tested the tuner’s accuracy
accuracy.p: Automated tests play generated tones at exact frequencies – 41.2 Hz (bass low E), 65.41 Hz (cello low C), 82.41 Hz (guitar low E), 440 Hz (A4) and 1318.5 Hz – into the same pitch detection this tuner uses, and every reading must be within ±1 cent. A browser test also plays a tone 20 cents sharp through the whole tuner and checks that it shows “Tune down” at 17–23 cents.

metronome.title: Metronome Online
metronome.accentHint: Tap a dot to accent that beat
metronome.how1: Set the tempo with the slider, the − / + buttons, or Tap tempo.
metronome.how2: Press Play. The screen flashes on every beat.
metronome.how3: Tap a beat dot to accent it.

chords.title: Guitar Chords & Piano Chords
chords.how1: Pick a root note and a chord type.
chords.how2: Press Play to hear it. Arrows show other shapes.
chords.how3: Use −1 / +1 to move the chord by a semitone.

about.title: About WowGuitar – Free Online Guitar Tuner & Music Tools
about.description: WowGuitar makes free online music tools: a guitar tuner, ukulele, violin, cello and bass tuners, a metronome online and a guitar and piano chord chart.
body: WowGuitar is a set of free online music tools that work the second a page opens: a guitar tuner, tuners for ukulele, violin, cello and bass, a chromatic tuner, a metronome online with tap tempo, and a guitar and piano chord chart with sound.
Everything runs in your browser – no app to install and no account to create – and the tools keep working offline after your first visit. The site is available in 15 languages.

The tuners read the note from your microphone with the McLeod Pitch Method. The sound is analysed on your own device and never uploaded. Automated tests check the pitch detection against generated tones at exact frequencies and require every reading to be within ±1 cent.
Questions, ideas or a mistake you spotted? Write to {email}.

contact.title: Contact WowGuitar – Guitar Tuner, Metronome & Chords
contact.description: Questions, feedback or a bug in the guitar tuner, metronome or chord chart? Email WowGuitar at hello@wowguitar.com.
body: The fastest way to reach us is by email: {email}.
Tell us which page you were on, the device and browser you use, and what happened. For a tuner problem, mention the instrument and whether you used the microphone or tuned by ear.
We read every message and are glad to hear about bugs, wrong translations and ideas for new tools.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy – WowGuitar
privacy.description: How WowGuitar handles your data: microphone audio stays on your device, settings stay in your browser, and Google Analytics measures site usage.
body: Last updated: {date}. This page explains what WowGuitar collects and why.

**Microphone.** The tuners ask for microphone access only when you tap “Tap to tune”. The sound is analysed in real time on your device to find the note. It is never recorded, stored or sent to a server.

**Settings in your browser.** Your choices – light or dark theme, A4 reference, reference tones, acoustic or electric headstock, volume and note names – are saved in your browser’s local storage so they are there next time. They never leave your device; clearing your browser data removes them.

**Analytics.** We use Google Analytics, loaded through Cloudflare Zaraz, to count visits and see which pages are used. It collects usage data such as pages viewed, approximate location, device and browser, and may set Google cookies. Google processes this data under its own privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy We also use Microsoft Clarity to see how people use our pages: it records clicks, scrolling and mouse movement (never microphone audio) and may set cookies. Microsoft processes this data under its privacy statement: https://www.microsoft.com/privacy/privacystatement
**Hosting.** Our hosting and network providers, Vercel and Cloudflare, process standard request data such as IP address and browser type to deliver and protect the site.
**No accounts.** We don’t ask for your name or email and we don’t sell data.
